S.FORM: Kkayal sa qutux ruax ryax na 'tayal hya sawn naha' qutux ryax hya' ga, sazing qu mcka' kkayal, qutux ga qlyan, qutux ga gbyan. qlyan hya' ga aring mayzbuq ru mhtuw wagi' ru kryaxan ru gaygbyan , yaqani qu sawn maha qlyan. gbyan hya ga, aring sa mzyup suruw na rgyax qu wagi' ru kska' bzngi' ru tayhuk slwan qani qu sawn maha gbyan. mayzbuq hya ga, aring min'aring tlapaw qu kayal ru mucing sa htgan wagi' ga yasa qu sawn mayzbuq. sasan hya ga, aring slwan qu kayal ru mkaraw wagi', ru zik kryaxan, ru kska' kryaxan ga yasa qu sawn maha sasan. babaw kinryax hya lga, aring kinryax lru msrihaw wagi' yani qu sawn maha babaw kinryax. ru htagan wagi' ru mzyup balay waqi' lga, yasa qu sawn maha gaygbyan la. mlhngan hya' ga, aring smsman ru kgbyan , ru pp'abi' , ru kska' bzngi' , ru min'aring mqwas ngta', minpusal mqwas ngta', ru mintaytzyul mqwas ngta', nanu' yaqu mintaytzyul mqwas ngta' lga, yasa qu mmawsa' qmayah lqu 'tayal la.
S.PHON: kkajal [s|ɕ]a qutux ruax rjax na ʔtajal ħja [s|ɕ]awn naħaʔ qutux rjax ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]aziŋ qu m[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ kkajal qutux ɣa qljan qutux ɣa ɣβjan qljan ħjaʔ ɣa ariŋ majzβuq ru mħtuw waɣiʔ ru krjaxan ru ɣajɣβjan jaqani qu [s|ɕ]awn maħa qljan ɣβjan ħja ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]a mzjup [s|ɕ]uruw na rɣjax qu waɣiʔ ru k[s|ɕ]kaʔ βzŋiʔ ru tajħuk [s|ɕ]lwan qani qu [s|ɕ]awn maħa ɣβjan majzβuq ħja ɣa ariŋ minʔariŋ tlapaw qu kajal ru mu[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ [s|ɕ]a ħtɣan waɣiʔ ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn majzβuq [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]an ħja ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]lwan qu kajal ru mkaraw waɣiʔ ru zik krjaxan ru k[s|ɕ]kaʔ krjaxan ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn maħa [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]an βaβaw kinrjax ħja lɣa ariŋ kinrjax lru m[s|ɕ]riħaw waɣiʔ jani qu [s|ɕ]awn maħa βaβaw kinrjax ru ħtaɣan waɣiʔ ru mzjup βalaj waqiʔ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn maħa ɣajɣβjan la mlħŋan ħjaʔ ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]m[s|ɕ]man ru kɣβjan ru ppʔaβiʔ ru k[s|ɕ]kaʔ βzŋiʔ ru minʔariŋ mqwa[s|ɕ] ŋtaʔ minpu[s|ɕ]al mqwa[s|ɕ] ŋtaʔ ru mintajtzjul mqwa[s|ɕ] ŋtaʔ nanuʔ jaqu mintajtzjul mqwa[s|ɕ] ŋtaʔ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu mmaw[s|ɕ]aʔ qmajaħ lqu ʔtajal la
